# dear_bindings (vendored generated output)

The C API for Dear ImGui, generated by
[dear_bindings](https://github.com/dearimgui/dear_bindings) (MIT) and published
with its releases. Plain files, not a submodule: the engine build consumes the
generated output only and needs neither the generator nor its Python
dependency (`ply`).

Release: `DearBindings_v0.21_ImGui_v1.92.8` (Dear ImGui `v1.92.8`).

The release tag names both versions. The ImGui half must equal the pinned
`third_party/imgui` tag; `core/CMakeLists.txt` compares `IMGUI_VERSION_NUM` in
`dcimgui.h` with the one in `third_party/imgui/imgui.h` at configure time and
fails on a mismatch.

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `dcimgui.h` | C declarations. Included by mods through `openpete_imgui.h`. |
| `dcimgui.cpp` | C++ implementation calling `ImGui::*`. Compiled into `openpete_imgui` with hidden visibility. |
| `dcimgui.json` | Metadata (signatures, varargs, array bounds, `#if` conditionals) read by `tools/gen_imgui_table.py`. |
| `LICENSE.txt` | MIT, upstream. |

## Updating

Bump `third_party/imgui` first, then

```
scripts/update-dear-bindings.sh
```

which reads `IMGUI_VERSION` from `third_party/imgui/imgui.h`, downloads the
four files from the matching release, rewrites the `Release:` line above, and
validates the download before installing it. Rebuild afterwards: the table
table is regenerated from `dcimgui.json`, its digest changes, and every source
mod recompiles at the next boot.
